decision.question: Is there reliable visual evidence of relevant attempted movement of the source mug, or reliable evidence that no relevant progress toward moving it to the right of the headphones occurred?
decision.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes relevant attempted movement of the source mug, even if fulfillment is not established. Fail only when visual evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Use unknown when neither attempted movement nor absence of progress can reliably be established. A remnant supports attempted movement only when its shape, position, and appearance reliably connect it to the source mug or otherwise clearly indicate a relevant edit; do not infer progress from color alone, an indistinct blur, or an unrelated mug.
decision.binding: Inspect the source mug's former location and surrounding edited scene for reliable evidence of attempted movement, including the remnant's position, outline, and appearance and any other visible changes. Compare the source mug's body and handle with edited objects, allowing for appearance changes. Keep attempted movement distinct from fulfillment: this check passes for reliable attempted movement, while the separate fulfillment check determines whether the requested placement is satisfied.
